title: Environmental Data Sources
content: Environmental data in Borneo Tracker may come from official statistical, satellite, institutional, public open-data, and public or third-party sources where applicable. Repository-supported source families include World Bank, UN SDG resources, Global Forest Watch, NASA FIRMS, government open-data portals, and WAQI / aqicn. Individual indicators preserve source, year, and update context where available; imported or transformed data should preserve source labels, units, geography, and year information.
